versions.label: Full-size print kit (pinFit 0.2 mm, print-tested)
Assembled guitar (single-piece display model)

notes.text: [WORKFLOW] Drive this app via window.partwright (see /ai.md). Use runAndSave(code, label, assertions) for iterations; after structural changes verify visually via renderViews (use views:"box" for an all-faces final check); addSessionNote with [REQUIREMENT]/[DECISION]/[MEASUREMENT]/[FEEDBACK]/[ATTEMPT]/[TODO] prefixes; getSessionContext() when resuming.
[REQUIREMENT] Full-size Prince Cloud guitar: realistic shape, ×4.4 scale (~1.05 m), must split for H2C printer.
[REQUIREMENT] Neck-to-headstock join must look seamless and elegant when printed.
[DECISION] Neck profile: 5.0 mm deep at nut, 5.8 mm at heel (22–26 mm full-size). Headstock tilted 10° back, not tilted down.
[DECISION] No neck pitch (0° by default). Nut and bridge stay level with the body.
[DECISION] Strings are optional (off by default for printing). No carbon-fibre reinforcement planned yet.
[DECISION] Tuner buttons are now rear-mounted (realistic) and will either be glued on or printed with supports, not constrained to print-flat orientation.
[DECISION] Bridge and tailpiece gaps restored; no longer flat-bottomed for printing.
[DECISION] Body thickness remains 7.5 mm (33 mm full-size); arm outward bow and edge rounding are parametric sliders.
[MEASUREMENT] Print-tested: the full-size print kit (Print kit part, default params) was physically printed and assembled; pinFit 0.2 mm is the confirmed friction fit for the alignment pins.
